mapLocation.label: Talk to Mord Gunnars at the northernmost dock of Rellekka.

itemsRequired.howToGet: Buy on the Grand Exchange, or from Gerrant's Fishy Business in Port Sarim for 40 gp.
itemsRequired.note: A raw tuna (obtainable during quest, with 35 fishing or bought from the shop)

itemsRequired.howToGet: Buy on the Grand Exchange, or from Drogo's Mining Emporium in Dwarven Mines for 3 gp.
itemsRequired.note: Either 8 tin ores, 7 pieces of coal, or 6 mithril ores (depends on your Mining level; level 1 will require tin ore, 2-54 will require coal, and 55-99 require mithril ore). Note: The ores can be noted.

itemsRequired.howToGet: Buy on the Grand Exchange, or from Ned's Handmade Rope (100% Wool) in Draynor Village for 16 gp.

itemsRequired.note: If the Neitiznot shield is already purchased, only 8 ropes are required.

itemsRequired.howToGet: Buy on the Grand Exchange, or from Funch's Fine Groceries in Grand Tree for 6 gp.

itemsRequired.note: 8 split logs (obtainable during the quest with 56 Woodcutting and an axe)
a Neitiznot shield (or 56 Woodcutting, a hammer and a bronze nail)
Yak-hide armour top and legs (or 46 Crafting, a needle and two thread, or a costume needle)

route.title: The jester outfit
steps: Talk to Mord Gunnars at the most northern dock in Rellekka to be taken to Jatizso. Dialogue: "Can you ferry me to Jatizso?"
Talk to King Gjuki Sorvott IV in the checkered floor room. His cat will intervene.
Use the raw tuna on the King's cat.
Speak to the King.
Give him the required ores.
Take all four pieces of the jester outfit from the chest behind the king's throne.
Quick travel back to Rellekka via Mord Gunnars at the docks to the south.

route.title: The spymaster's first task
steps: Quick travel to Neitiznot via Maria Gunnars on the docks next to Mord.
Remove anything from your weapon and shield slots and put on the Jester outfit (hat, boots, tights, top)
Speak with Slug Hemligssen north of the bank. Dialogue: "Free stuff please.", "I am ready."
Talk to Mawnis Burowgar in the building south of the bank.
During the cutscene, follow the commands Mawnis gives using the right-side panel.
Return to Slug Hemligssen. He will give you 2500 coins. Dialogue: "Yes I have.", "They will be ready in two days.", "Seventeen militia have been trained.", "There are two bridges to repair.",

route.title: Bridge repairs
steps: Speak to Mawnis Burowgar again without the Jester Outfit
Speak to Mawnis Burowgar with the ropes, split logs, and knife in your inventory with at least one empty inventory slot.
Speak to Thakkrad to learn how to repair the bridges. Dialogue: "How do I repair these bridges again?"
Travel north, across the rope bridge and repair the broken bridges on the east and west sides of the island (right-click option to repair).
Talk to Mawnis Burowgar.
Quick travel back to Rellekka via Maria Gunnars at the dock to the south-west.

route.title: The king's tax collector
steps: Quick travel to Jatizso via Mord.
Speak with King Gjuki Sorvott IV in the building west of the bank.
Tax the shop keepers of Jatizso:
Talk to King Gjuki Sorvott IV.
Collect taxes from the following people for 1,000:
Speak with King Gjuki Sorvott IV.
Quick travel back to Rellekka via Mord.

route.title: The spymaster's second task
steps: Quick travel to Neitiznot via Maria.
Speak with Spymaster Slug Hemligssen again.
Equip only the jester outfit again.
Speak with Mawnis to induce another Jester cutscene.
Speak with Slug once again. Dialogue: "Yes, I am.", "They are in a secluded bay, near Etceteria.", "They will be given some potions.", "I have been helping Neitiznot."
Ferry back to Rellekka and then to Jatizso.
Speak to King Gjuki Sorvott IV to obtain the royal decree (1 inv spot needed, otherwise you have to repeat dialogue).
Travel back to Neitiznot and speak with Mawnis. (Don't forget to take off the jester outfit)
Buy yak-hide armour (top and leggings), along with the Neitiznot shield from the Grand Exchange, or for Ironmen:
Speak with Mawnis, who will instruct you to craft a shield. For Ironmen:
Speak with Mawnis again.

route.title: The troll king
steps: Equip the Neitiznot shield and combat items to fight the Ice Troll King.
Use Protect from Melee while running to the east side cave entrance of the farthest north isle.
Enter the cave to start a cutscene.
Kill ten trolls, you will see a message saying "You have defeated enough trolls to attack the King."
Turn on Protect from Missiles before crossing the bridge.
Turn on Protect from Magic for the duration of the fight. Kill the troll king. DO NOT use Protect from Melee because King will use the long distance attack as Dad does.
Decapitate the troll king's corpse.
Return to Mawnis Burowgar.
Congratulations, quest complete!
